# Test dependencies for openframe-adapters local development
#
# CI does NOT use this file.
# Each adapter installs its own dev extras directly:
#   cd packages/openframe-adapters-db-postgres && pip install -e ".[dev]"
#   cd packages/openframe-adapters-db-mongo    && pip install -e ".[dev]"
#
# This file is a convenience shortcut for running all adapter tests locally
# from the repo root without entering each package directory:
#   pip install -r .github/requirements/test.txt
#   pytest packages/

# ── Test runner ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pytest>=8.0
pytest-asyncio>=0.23
pytest-mock>=3.14

# ── Adapter runtime deps ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Pinned at minimum supported floors — mirrors each adapter's pyproject.toml.

# openframe-adapters-db-postgres
asyncpg>=0.29

# openframe-adapters-db-mongo
motor>=3.3
pymongo>=4.6

# ── Shared transitive dep ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# openframe-core is a direct dependency of every adapter package.
# Pinned here to lock the local environment against the minimum supported version.
openframe-core>=1.0,<2
